title: Quick Play: see who's here and get into a game fast
summary: The Pro lobby now shows who else is picking a fighter right now. Wave at someone to ask for a game, or hit Quick Match to pair up with whoever has waited longest. For a limited time, Quick Match games pay 2× XP.
body: When someone accepts your wave you're matched straight away: pick your fighter and press Go. Their pick shows on your roster, and you'll know the moment they're ready.
Every Quick Play game is a duel on a 60-second move timer. Quick Match rolls a random board; after a wave, the player who accepted picks it.
Rather stay out of the lobby? Switch the Visible toggle next to the player count to Hidden and nobody will see you or wave at you.
